notes: The 'Starting Info' says: Ops – Battle Order; Yavin IV Throne Tech and Tatooine Drain – Crush; 'Against mostly everything else- Start IAO'. starting.effect is Imperial Arrest Order (the default named); the Objective's own sites are not marked in the list.
Posted 'Death Star Docking Bay 94' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (the strategy calls it the 'D*DB'; Docking Bay 94 is on Tatooine).

Posted 'EPP Darth Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'ECC IG-88' IG-88 With Riot Gun (Enhanced Cloud City); 'EJP Dengar' Dengar With Blaster Carbine (Enhanced Jabba's Palace); 'Boba Fett in Slave 1' Boba Fett In Slave I.
Battle Order is the Endor Effect (Endor was released in May 2000; posted 22 February 2000). Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward are the Special Edition Effects (no Defensive Shields in 2000).
